label: Anime Film Look
description: Theatrical anime production looks — how a feature film's animation, backgrounds and photography pass actually read on screen. Characteristics only, no studio or artist names.

items.name: painted-cel-classic
items.text: classic cel-era feature look, hand-inked outlines photographed over gouache-painted backgrounds, the background a complete painting with visible brush texture while characters hold flat confident color, gentle rostrum-camera halation on the brightest highlights

items.name: modern-digital-feature
items.text: modern digital feature look, razor-clean line art composited over multi-layered painted backgrounds, the photography pass adding depth-graded haze, soft bloom and a breath of chromatic offset in the frame corners

items.name: watercolor-art-film
items.text: art-house watercolor feature look, backgrounds left deliberately unfinished toward the frame edges, washes pooling into visible paper grain, characters drawn with a trembling pencil line that keeps the animator's hand

items.name: effects-spectacle
items.text: effects-animation spectacle look, hand-drawn fire, water and light rendered as bold graphic shapes with stepped shading, impact frames flashing to inverted color, speed lines carved through the paint

items.name: photo-hybrid
items.text: photography-heavy hybrid look, painted characters over near-photographic background plates, lens artifacts drawn in by hand — polygonal flares, breathing focus, a vignette that behaves like real glass

items.name: noir-feature
items.text: monochrome noir feature look, heavy toned-paper blacks, figures emerging from crosshatched darkness, single highlights placed as if ink were expensive

items.name: vintage-film-print
items.text: aged theatrical print look, dye layers faded toward amber, faint gate weave and reel-change cue marks, grain dancing in the dark passages of every painted background

items.name: flat-graphic-feature
items.text: graphic modern feature look, flat poster-like color fields with hard shadow shapes, backgrounds simplified to bold geometry, characters placed like cutouts in a designed frame

items.name: storybook-feature
items.text: storybook feature look, colored-pencil texture and soft rounded forms, edges lit with warm rim glow, every frame composed like a picture-book spread
